about: Dependencies a maintainer reviewed and accepted although scripts/license-check.mjs flags their license. Each entry: {"name": "<npm package>", "license": "<exact license string the check reports>", "reason": "<why it is acceptable>"}. See haxtheweb/issues#3262.

reviewed.name: @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64
reviewed.reason: Prebuilt libvips binary that sharp (image resizing in @haxtheweb/haxcms-nodejs) loads as a separate, unmodified library the user can replace. The packaged app carries the LGPL text, a source offer and the libvips notices in src/legal-notices.
